verdict.rationale: The only interactive surface in the evidence is a Cloud Console playground that runs without a key or install, plus a quickstart with SDK install snippets. None of this is an interactive API reference with runnable per-endpoint examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at any standard path. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference (try-it-out per endpoint), runnable examples embedded in the reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
